rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Integrates with Cisco ACI (Application Centric Infrastructure) fabrics through the APIC REST API, providing comprehensive network automation capabilities for managing tenants, application profiles, endpoint groups, bridge domains, VRFs, and contracts. Built with TypeScript and supports both username/password and X.509 certificate authentication for secure access. Features configurable tool selection modes to balance between core functionality and extended capabilities, with robust error handling and automatic session management for production network automation workflows.
